# cloudsmith_oidc (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `claims` (Map of String) The claims associated with these provider settings
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the provider settings should be used for incoming OIDC requests.
- `name` (String) The name of the provider settings are being configured for
- `namespace` (String) Namespace to which this OIDC config belongs.
- `provider_url` (String) The URL from the provider that serves as the base for the OpenID configuration.

### Optional

- `dynamic_mappings` (Block Set) Set of dynamic claim value -> service account mappings (order-insensitive, authoritative). Mutually exclusive with service_accounts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--dynamic_mappings))
- `mapping_claim` (String) The claim key whose values dynamically map to service accounts (dynamic providers only). Mutually exclusive with service_accounts.
- `service_accounts` (List of String) The service accounts associated with these provider settings (static providers only). Mutually exclusive with mapping_claim/dynamic_mappings.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `slug` (String) The slug identifies the oidc.
- `slug_perm` (String) The slug_perm identifies the oidc.

<a id="nestedblock--dynamic_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dynamic_mappings`

Required:

- `claim_value` (String) The value of the mapping claim.
- `service_account` (String) Service account slug mapped to the claim value.
